articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Jim Cramer Picks Micron, Applied Materials And Intel Or AMD As Top Semiconductor Bets After AI Selloff, Says Supermicro Is 'Great For Nvidia'
articles.summary: Jim Cramer picked Micron, AMAT, and Intel or AMD as his top semiconductor stocks after the AI-driven tech selloff.
articles._summary: Taking to X, Cramer wrote, “OK, IF you have to, lets go with Micron, AMAT and Intel/AMD for the ones I like the best….for this part of the food chain.” “Supermicro great for Nvidia if you are counting,” he said. The comments came a day after Cramer urged investors to reduce oversized technology positions, warning that the AI trade had become increasingly volatile despite maintaining his long-term bullish stance on companies including Nvidia and Intel.
articles._zh_headline: 吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 选择美光、应用材料和英特尔或 AMD 作为 AI 抛售后半导体行业的最佳赌注，称超微“对英伟达来说非常有利”
articles._zh_summary: 对于 X，Cramer 写道：“好吧，如果必须的话，让我选择 Micron、AMAT 和 Intel/AMD 吧，因为我最喜欢这些……对于食物链的这一部分。” “如果你算的话，超微对英伟达来说非常有利，”他说。克莱默发表上述言论的前一天，他敦促投资者减少过多的科技头寸，并警告称，尽管他保持对英伟达和英特尔等公司的长期看涨立场，但人工智能行业的波动性却越来越大。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: SK Hynix Dismisses Intel Ohio Buyout Report: 'We Have No Plans for an Acquisition' (UPDATED)
articles.summary: SK hynix denied a report it was in talks to buy Intel's Ohio chip campus, saying it has neither pursued nor decided on a deal.
articles._summary: SK hynix issued the clarification in a Korea Exchange filing after Korea JoongAng Daily reported that the company was negotiating to acquire the Ohio campus to establish front-end memory chip production in the U.S. within five years. In the filing, SK hynix said it is “continuously reviewing various investment and acquisition opportunities for business purposes,” but added that it “has not pursued or decided to acquire Intel’s Ohio site and Fab.”
articles._zh_headline: SK 海力士否认英特尔俄亥俄州收购报告：“我们没有收购计划”（已更新）
articles._zh_summary: 韩国《中央日报》报道称，SK 海力士正在谈判收购俄亥俄州工厂，以便在五年内在美国建立前端存储芯片生产基地，之后，SK 海力士在韩国交易所提交的文件中做出了澄清。 SK海力士在文件中表示，它“正在不断审查出于商业目的的各种投资和收购机会”，但补充说，它“尚未寻求或决定收购英特尔俄亥俄州工厂和晶圆厂”。

articles.author: Badar Shaikh
articles.headline: Elon Musk Needs to 'Shore Up Credibility,' Stop Making 'Outlandish' Promises, Says Gary Black Ahead of Tesla's Q2 Earnings
articles.summary: Investor Gary Black slams Tesla CEO Elon Musk's Robotaxi promises, says company needs better communication and credibility.
articles._summary: He shared that while GM and Ford’s autonomous efforts were not superior to Tesla’s, “Elon keeps making outlandish promises” like Tesla Robotaxis serving 50% of the U.S. population by the end of last year. “The comms at TSLA are sorely lacking and @elonmusk needs to bring on 1-2 adults to shore up credibility,” the investor said, delivering sharp criticism of the company, as well as its lack of communications and PR.
articles._zh_headline: 加里·布莱克在特斯拉第二季度财报公布前表示，埃隆·马斯克需要“增强可信度”，停止做出“古怪”的承诺
articles._zh_summary: 他表示，虽然通用汽车和福特在自动驾驶方面的努力并不比特斯拉优越，但“埃隆不断做出一些奇怪的承诺”，比如特斯拉机器人出租车到去年年底将为 50% 的美国人口提供服务。这位投资者表示：“TSLA 的沟通非常缺乏，@elonmusk 需要聘请 1-2 名成年人来增强可信度。”他对公司以及缺乏沟通和公关提出了尖锐的批评。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Elon Musk Denies Report Claiming Foxconn Won $52 Billion SpaceX AI Server Deal: 'This Is Fake News'
articles.summary: Elon Musk rejected claims SpaceX awarded Foxconn a $52B billion AI server contract, saying the report was "fake news."
articles._summary: Musk responded to an X user who shared the report and said, “Jesus that’s a lot of compute,” replying, “This is fake news.” Foxconn and SpaceX did not immediately respond to Benzinga’s requests for clarification. “If Supermicro did that well, Dell should be incredible,” Cramer said in a post on X. Dell is scheduled to report fiscal year 2027 second quarter earnings on September 3.
articles._zh_headline: 埃隆·马斯克否认有关富士康赢得 SpaceX 520 亿美元人工智能服务器交易的报道：“这是假新闻”
articles._zh_summary: 马斯克在回复一位分享该报告的 X 用户时表示，“天哪，这需要大量的计算”，并回答道：“这是假新闻。”富士康和 SpaceX 没有立即回应 Benzinga 的澄清请求。克莱默在 X 上发帖称：“如果超微做得这么好，戴尔应该会令人难以置信。”戴尔定于 9 月 3 日公布 2027 财年第二季度收益。
